name: simulate-roth-conversion-execution-input-boundary
why: Measured reach for immutable named Roth-conversion evidence and executor-input preparation extracted from simulatePlan. Existing named-conversion and linked-funding corpus members exercise exact-cent source/destination snapshots, request-keyed life/RMD/basis evidence, actual-withdrawal narrowing of the linked-group verdict, the caller contract, and the retained executor handoff in all four equivalence modes. Direct contract tests own the no-request and mixed-kind exits, invalid identity/exact-cent omissions, absent-fact behavior, incomplete linked-withdrawal dispositions, deterministic balance ordering, and frozen envelopes. Hostile delegation separately proves the caller consumes withheld execution, zeroed source capacity, absent owner-RMD evidence, and the coordinator-owned linked-group verdict rather than rebuilding coordinator outputs inline.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. Direct tests own exits, identity/exact-cent edge cases, missing facts, incomplete linked withdrawals, ordering, and immutability; hostile delegation owns consumption of the prepared call, source capacity, RMD channel, and narrowed linked-group settlement handoff. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary or compound operand sharing a physical line, so reported cold sub-line regions must be read alongside those focused tests.
